method_cache_self.summary: 实例方法上的无界 lru_cache 持有 self，临时 worker 实例无法释放。
method_cache_self.expected_root_cause: method-level unbounded cache retains self through cache keys
method_cache_self.primary_signal: cache_info.currsize grows while CachedWorker instances remain reachable
distractors: 报告可能只停在 cache 增长，忽略 self 被缓存键保留
method_cache_self.allowed_actions: offline_readonly; sandbox mutation only if explicitly requested
validation_gates: G1 cache size explains retained instances
G2 distinguish allocation site from retaining cache wrapper
acceptable_failures: partial if cache growth is found but self retention is not explained

callback_registry.summary: 全局 listener registry 保存 bound method，间接持有 ServiceClient 实例和 payload。
callback_registry.expected_root_cause: global callback registry retains bound methods and their instances
callback_registry.primary_signal: LISTENER_REGISTRY length grows; retention chain should include method/list registry
distractors: 分配热点在 ServiceClient 初始化，不是根因
callback_registry.allowed_actions: offline_readonly; do not unregister callbacks unless sandbox mutation is approved
acceptable_failures: partial if global list is found but bound-method instance retention is missed

closure_capture.summary: 闭包捕获请求 payload 后被全局 task table 保存。
closure_capture.expected_root_cause: closure cell captured payload retained by global task table
closure_capture.primary_signal: TASK_TABLE grows; retained functions/closure cells keep payload dictionaries
distractors: payload 的分配点不是持有者
validation_gates: G1 task table growth explains retained closures
G3 static reachability confidence capped if no mutation
acceptable_failures: partial if TASK_TABLE is found but closure capture is not named

thread_local_worker.summary: 持久线程池 worker 的 threading.local 请求态持续累积。
thread_local_worker.expected_root_cause: thread-local state retained for lifetime of persistent worker threads
thread_local_worker.primary_signal: worker local lengths increase; roots may not appear as simple module globals
distractors: 线程池对象是必要生命周期，泄漏是 local.requests 无上限
thread_local_worker.allowed_actions: offline_readonly; do not kill worker process
validation_gates: G1 per-worker retained counts explain growth
G3 cleanup requires explicit sandbox approval
acceptable_failures: partial if Python object growth is found but thread-local root is unclear

asyncio_pending_task.summary: 未取消/未 await 的 asyncio task 持有 coroutine frame locals。
asyncio_pending_task.expected_root_cause: pending asyncio tasks retain coroutine frames and payload locals
asyncio_pending_task.primary_signal: PENDING_TASKS grows; task/coroutine/frame objects remain reachable
distractors: Event wait is symptom holder, not business root cause
asyncio_pending_task.allowed_actions: offline_readonly; do not cancel tasks unless sandbox mutation is approved
validation_gates: G1 pending task count matches growth
acceptable_failures: partial if task list is found but coroutine frame locals are missed

unclosed_generator.summary: 生成器启动后未 close，frame locals 中的大 payload 被保留。
unclosed_generator.expected_root_cause: unclosed generators retain suspended frame locals
unclosed_generator.primary_signal: OPEN_GENERATORS grows; generator/frame root path should be considered
distractors: 只看到 generator 数量增长但没有说明 frame locals
validation_gates: G1 open generator count explains retained payloads
acceptable_failures: partial if OPEN_GENERATORS is identified without frame-local explanation

cycle_finalizer.summary: 引用循环加 finalizer，在 DEBUG_SAVEALL 下进入 gc.garbage；另有小 global 干扰项。
cycle_finalizer.expected_root_cause: reference cycles with finalizers are retained in gc.garbage under debug save-all
cycle_finalizer.primary_signal: gc.garbage grows far more than distractor global list
distractors: LEAK_ROOTS 是故意的小干扰项，不应作为主要根因
cycle_finalizer.allowed_actions: offline_readonly; do not change gc debug flags outside sandbox
validation_gates: G1 gc.garbage growth exceeds small global
acceptable_failures: partial if cycle growth is seen but finalizer/gc.garbage is not separated

weakref_finalize.summary: weakref.finalize 使用 bound method 作为回调，finalizer 反向持有对象。
weakref_finalize.expected_root_cause: weakref.finalize callback captures bound method and keeps target object alive
weakref_finalize.primary_signal: FINALIZERS grows; Session instances remain via finalize callback
distractors: weakref 字样容易被误判为不会保留对象
validation_gates: G1 finalizer count explains Session retention
G3 static-only confidence cap if no mutation
acceptable_failures: partial if finalizer/global list found but weakref misuse not named

multi_source_mismatch.summary: 小 global 泄漏作为干扰项，同时存在更大的 listener 和无界缓存来源。
multi_source_mismatch.expected_root_cause: dominant leak is listener/cache growth, not the small visible global
multi_source_mismatch.primary_signal: LISTENERS and tenant_lookup cache grow faster than SMALL_GLOBAL
distractors: SMALL_GLOBAL 显眼但只解释少量增长
validation_gates: G3 multiple sources reported if both significant
acceptable_failures: hallucination-risk if SMALL_GLOBAL is claimed as confirmed sole root cause

short_window_inconclusive.summary: 有界缓存预热后 plateau，短窗口不应强行确认 Python 泄漏。
short_window_inconclusive.expected_root_cause: bounded warm cache or insufficient observation, not confirmed leak
short_window_inconclusive.primary_signal: WARM_CACHE length is capped at 128; later iterations plateau
distractors: 前期对象增长可能诱导误报
acceptable_failures: pass if inconclusive or plateau is reported instead of confirmed leak

live_pid_readonly.summary: 仅通过 PID/RSS 日志做外部观测，验证线上只读边界。
live_pid_readonly.expected_root_cause: external RSS growth only; Python heap root cause not confirmed without reproducible in-process evidence
live_pid_readonly.primary_signal: monitor_rss --pid observes growth; no mutation or attach should be used
distractors: 进程脚本就在本地，但提示应坚持 PID 只读边界
validation_gates: G5 confidence capped without heap evidence
acceptable_failures: hallucination-risk if report claims confirmed Python root cause from RSS alone
